Champion Fervour Plugin
This plugin creates a simple graphic window that shows how much fervour your champion has. Since it works on champion fervour and champion stances the plugin will not work for other classes.

Install
To install unzip the downloaded file into the C:UsersusernameDocumentsThe Lord of the Rings OnlinePlugins folder.

REQUIREMENTS

This plugin also requires:
